note: One lead schema for every Imperial site. The forms post these field names; netlify/functions/lib/core.js reads them. A site sets only its site key and its default division. Names and allowed values are final; a field not listed here is ignored by the core.

citizenship.name: Imperial Citizenship
citizenship.tbc: TO CONFIRM: site goes live on the shared core

partners-club.name: Imperial Partners Club
partners-club.tbc: TO CONFIRM: site goes live on the shared core

private-office.name: Imperial Private Office
private-office.tbc: TO CONFIRM: site goes live on the shared core

real-estate.name: Imperial Real Estate
real-estate.tbc: TO CONFIRM: site goes live on the shared core

academy.name: Imperial Academy
academy.tbc: TO CONFIRM: site goes live on the shared core

journeys.note: The Start a relationship journey (docs/RELATIONSHIP-JOURNEY.md) posts the contact form. The path is the audience value; it sets the Pipedrive Contact Type and which screens follow. The entry point (via) is not a field: it stays in the query string of page.

enquiry.label: Enquiry card on the home page and the division pages, also used by the programme fit check

contact.label: Start a relationship: the chooser and the three paths

phone.note: With country code. Normalised to E.164 when possible.

country.note: Country of residence, free text. Written to the Pipedrive person field only when it matches an option label.

msg.where: every form except guide; optional on contact (the structured answers carry the first conversation)

about.where: contact: the first screen of the Private Clients and Professional Partners paths, hidden (group) on the Institutions path, or ?about from a division page

interests.where: contact: the Partners scope screen, the Institutions explore screen (chosen labels, comma separated) and the house finder goals (hidden)

pref.where: contact closing screen (Email, Phone call, Either)

nationality.where: contact: Private Clients path, citizenship and private-office routes only, optional; enquiry
nationality.note: One or more, free text. Written to the Pipedrive person field only when it matches an option label; otherwise it goes in the note.

for_whom.where: contact: Private Clients path (asked), Professional Partners path (client when introducing); enquiry

timeline.where: contact: every path (required for clients and introductions, optional otherwise); enquiry

labels.undisclosed: I would rather not say yet

budget.where: contact: Private Clients path, citizenship and real-estate routes only, optional; enquiry (optional)

firm.where: contact: Professional Partners path (firm) and Institutions path (organisation), both required

profession.where: contact: Professional Partners path (profession, required) and Institutions path (role, optional)

org_type.note: The only field new in v6. No custom field in Pipedrive: it goes in the note (Organisation line) and to Imperial OS.

quiz_answers.where: hidden; contact when the programme fit check handed over (lead_source programme-fit), enquiry
quiz_answers.note: JSON string of the five answers.

cf-turnstile-response.where: hidden, only when Turnstile is on

score.note: Points add up; the band is written as the Pipedrive label, a [HOT] or [WARM] title prefix, and in the note.
score.exploringCap: When the timeline is 'exploring' or missing, the band is at most warm, and warm then needs exploringWarm points.
